boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost ways to explore art, outdoors, and public university programming in University, Mississippi.

cards.title: Tour the University Museum galleries
cards.subtitle: 412 University Avenue, University, MS
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a self-guided gallery visit; the museum lists free admission and asks visitors to use its University Avenue campus entrance.
cards.short_summary: A free public art-and-artifacts gallery visit.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Mississippi Museum is open to the public and has free admission.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sunday, Monday, and most university holidays.

cards.title: Walk Bailey Woods Trail
cards.subtitle: Between the University Museum and Rowan Oak, University, MS
cards.notes: Take the marked walk between the museum and Rowan Oak; plan roughly a half-hour and use the museum-side bike rack, restrooms, and water fountain.
cards.short_summary: A free daily trail linking two university cultural sites.
cards.evidence_claim: Bailey Woods Trail is free, open daily from dawn to dusk, and connects the Museum and Rowan Oak.
cards.access_notes: Open from dawn to dusk daily; the museum page advises allowing about a half-hour for the trail.

cards.title: Stroll the Rowan Oak grounds
cards.subtitle: Rowan Oak, University, MS
cards.notes: Use the grounds for a daylight walk or a pause after the Bailey Woods Trail; keep the visit outdoors to avoid the separate house-interior fee.
cards.short_summary: Free outdoor access at William Faulkner’s former home.
cards.evidence_claim: The grounds at Rowan Oak are open without charge, while interior access costs $5 per visitor.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are open dawn to dusk daily. This card excludes the paid Rowan Oak house interior.

cards.title: Draw at Sketchbook Saturdays
cards.subtitle: University of Mississippi Museum, University, MS
cards.notes: Drop into the museum galleries with your own sketchbook or use museum materials; seating is provided for a relaxed, self-guided drawing session.
cards.short_summary: A free all-ages gallery sketching session.
cards.evidence_claim: Sketchbook Saturdays is a free, all-ages self-guided sketching session held during Saturday museum hours.
cards.access_notes: Drop in Saturdays during museum operating hours, 10 a.m.–4 p.m., excluding university holidays.

cards.entity_name: University of Mississippi Museum Exhibition Openings
cards.title: Catch a Museum exhibition opening
cards.subtitle: University of Mississippi Museum, University, MS
cards.notes: Check the museum calendar, then attend an exhibition opening with a friend; the museum invites the public and identifies these offerings as free.
cards.short_summary: Public, no-cost openings for new museum exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum invites the public to exhibition openings and identifies museum admission as free.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the date and exhibition before going; museum hours and holiday closures apply.

cards.entity_name: University of Mississippi Museum Brown Bag Lecture Series
cards.title: Attend a Brown Bag lecture
cards.subtitle: University of Mississippi Museum, University, MS
cards.notes: Look for a Brown Bag lecture on the museum calendar and arrive during the listed program window; the museum invites the public to the series.
cards.short_summary: A public museum lecture series with free museum access.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum invites the public to its Brown Bag lecture series and lists museum admission as free.
cards.access_notes: Dates vary; verify the scheduled lecture before visiting.

cards.title: Join Free Sketch Fridays
cards.subtitle: University of Mississippi Museum, University, MS
cards.notes: Use the museum’s program listing to find a Free Sketch Friday, then bring a sketchbook and spend time with the galleries at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A named free museum sketching program.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum invites the public to Free Sketch Fridays and lists museum admission as free.
cards.access_notes: Check the museum calendar for an offered date; regular museum hours and closures apply.

cards.entity_name: University of Mississippi Museum Family Activity Days
cards.title: Attend a Museum Family Activity Day
cards.subtitle: University of Mississippi Museum, University, MS
cards.notes: If you are visiting with younger relatives or friends, check for a Family Activity Day; the museum lists the public program among its free offerings.
cards.short_summary: A public, all-ages museum activity program.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum invites the public to Family Activity Days, notes all ages are welcome, and lists museum admission as free.
cards.access_notes: Programming dates vary; check the museum calendar before attending.

cards.title: Go to a SouthTalks program
cards.subtitle: Barnard Observatory, University, MS
cards.notes: Choose a lecture, performance, screening, or panel from the Center for the Study of Southern Culture’s listings and confirm the location before you go.
cards.short_summary: Free public talks and cultural programs at or near Barnard Observatory.
cards.evidence_claim: SouthTalks programs are free and open to the public and include lectures, performances, film screenings, and panel discussions.
cards.source_title: SouthTalks | Center for the Study of Southern Culture
cards.access_notes: The series typically takes place in the Tupelo Room of Barnard Observatory; confirm the specific event location and time.

cards.title: Spend an afternoon at Mississippi Day
cards.subtitle: The Circle, Galtney-Lott Plaza, and Student Union, University, MS
cards.notes: Plan around the annual open house for hands-on demonstrations and outdoor activities; food may be offered for purchase, but attending the event is free.
cards.short_summary: A free public campus open house with demonstrations and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Mississippi Day is a free, family-friendly celebration open to the public with academic demonstrations and interactive experiences.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; review the university’s current schedule before making plans. Food vendors are optional purchases.
